text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — prioritization for console telemetry next quarter. Focus candidates: dashboards (prebuilt templates), tracing hooks, per-route cost breakdown, and error analytics. Need launch criteria + scope tradeoffs by EOD Thu.
Dan (Eng): Can we rank "must-have" vs "nice-to-have"? I'm worried about backend work on sampling and storage.
Sophia (SRE): Must-have IMO: tracing hooks + retention policies. Without sampling/limits we'll blow logs budget.
Leo (Design): Templates are low-effort if we reuse existing components, but we should prototype 2 dashboard flows: infra ops view + product owner cost view.
Arjun (CSE): Customers repeatedly ask for per-api-key cost breakdown and alerting on cost spikes. That should be prioritized for upsell.
Dan (Eng): Proposal: Phase 1 = dashboards (templates + per-route cost panel), tracing hooks (basic span + trace id in logs), error analytics (grouping + first-seen). Phase 2 = advanced sampling, query export, RBAC controls.
Maya (PM): Good. We need launch criteria for Phase 1. Draft suggestion: 1) Templates for infra & product with <3 clicks to view; 2) Traces linked from error events and console logs; 3) Cost panel shows last-7d per-route and per-api-key; 4) Error grouping with basic root-cause tags; 5) Rollout with canary (10% orgs) + fallback to legacy. Thoughts?
Sophia (SRE): Add SLO: telemetry query latency p95 < 300ms for dashboard queries, and storage ingest < 150ms per event. Also retention defaults (30d) and an opt-in 90d.
Leo (Design): UX acceptance: templates populated with real sample data, empty-state guidance, and a 'Why am I seeing this cost?' inline help.
Dan (Eng): We need to estimate effort. Rough numbers: dashboards + cost panel: 3 dev-weeks; trace hooks + linking: 2 dev-weeks; error grouping UI: 1.5 dev-weeks; infra + retention + config: 2 dev-weeks. Total ~8.5 dev-weeks. Could parallelize.
Maya (PM): OK — tradeoffs: if we cut scope, drop 90d retention and advanced sampling from Phase 1. Keep per-api-key cost as it's high ROI.
Arjun (CSE): Confirm per-api-key data is available today? Some customers use hashed keys. We may need mapping + consent.
Dan (Eng): We have api_key in logs but hashed for some clients. Work: map hashed -> org via consent table; estimate 1 sprint of infra work if we include historical backfill.
Maya (PM): Launch metrics (what we measure for go/no-go): 1) Adoption: 20% of active orgs view dashboards within 2 weeks; 2) Cost visibility: 90% of API keys show non-empty cost line; 3) Stability: no more than 1 critical incident caused by telemetry in first month; 4) Query performance p95 < 300ms.
Sophia (SRE): Add canary monitoring: error rate, ingestion lag, storage growth per-org. TelemetryBot will create the canary alert playbook.
TelemetryBot: Note: canary alert template created -> /playbooks/telemetry-canary.json :thumbsup:
Leo (Design): Timeline check — can we ship a beta to 10 customers in 6 weeks?
Dan (Eng): If we start next sprint and parallelize frontend/backend, 6 weeks is tight but doable for Phase 1 beta (no 90d retention).
Maya (PM): Action items: Dan + Sophia to confirm infra estimate and canary metrics by Tue; Leo to drop mockups for two templates by Wed; Arjun to compile top 5 customer asks on cost views by Wed EOD. I'll synthesize launch criteria doc and circulate.
Arjun (CSE): I'll ping top accounts and add examples (org-level + api-key).
Dan (Eng): One more thing — we should add a small API for exporting telemetry to S3 for large customers. Phase 1: export as CSV via adhoc job. Phase 2: streaming export.
Maya (PM): Noted. We'll treat export as a Phase 1 stretch.
Sophia (SRE): If anyone hits storage concerns, tag ops-alert and we'll throttle ingestion.
Maya (PM): Thanks all. If no major objections I’ll move Phase 1 scope as proposed and post a short spec. :rocket:
